/* Resume text import. All parsing stays in this browser; no upload or OCR API. */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
  const MAX_PAGES = 20;
  const MAX_TEXT = 200000;
  const MAX_DOC_XML = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
  const currentScript = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.currentScript : null;
  const scriptURL = currentScript && currentScript.src ? currentScript.src :
    (typeof document !== 'undefined' ? new URL('importer.js', document.baseURI).href : 'http://localhost/importer.js');
  const baseURL = new URL('.', scriptURL);
  let pdfPromise;
  let zipPromise;

  function fail(message) { throw new Error(message); }

  function cleanText(value) {
    return String(value || '').replace(/\u0000/g, '').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n')
      .replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n').replace(/\n{4,}/g, '\n\n\n').trim();
  }

  function finish(value, format, note) {
    const text = cleanText(value);
    if (!text) fail('没有读取到文字。请换一个文件，或将简历文字粘贴到输入框。');
    if (text.length > MAX_TEXT) fail('文件里的文字过多，请只保留简历正文后重新导入。');
    return { text: text, format: format, note: note };
  }

  function getPDF() {
    // The standalone HTML embeds these tools and their binary resources. This
    // path performs no file:// module import or network request.
    if (globalThis.CareerPathOfflineReader?.pdfjs) {
      return Promise.resolve(globalThis.CareerPathOfflineReader.pdfjs);
    }
    if (!pdfPromise) {
      pdfPromise = import(new URL('pdf-compat.mjs', baseURL).href)
        .then(function () { return import(new URL('vendor/pdf.mjs', baseURL).href); })
        .then(function (pdfjs) {
          pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = new URL('pdf.worker.compat.mjs', baseURL).href;
          return pdfjs;
        }).catch(function () {
          pdfPromise = null;
          fail('浏览器未能加载PDF读取工具。请刷新后再试，或将简历文字粘贴到输入框。');
        });
    }
    return pdfPromise;
  }

  function getZip() {
    if (globalThis.JSZip) return Promise.resolve(globalThis.JSZip);
    if (!zipPromise) {
      zipPromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = new URL('vendor/jszip.min.js', baseURL).href;
        script.onload = function () {
          if (globalThis.JSZip) resolve(globalThis.JSZip);
          else reject(new Error('DOCX读取工具未加载成功，请刷新或粘贴简历文字。'));
        };
        script.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('DOCX读取工具未加载成功，请刷新或粘贴简历文字。')); };
        document.head.appendChild(script);
      }).catch(function (error) { zipPromise = null; throw error; });
    }
    return zipPromise;
  }

  async function readText(file) {
    const data = await file.arrayBuffer();
    let value;
    let encoding = 'UTF-8';
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(data);
    if (bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xfe) {
      value = new TextDecoder('utf-16le').decode(data);
      encoding = 'UTF-16';
    } else if (bytes[0] === 0xfe && bytes[1] === 0xff) {
      value = new TextDecoder('utf-16be').decode(data);
      encoding = 'UTF-16';
    } else {
      try { value = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(data); }
      catch (_) {
        try { value = new TextDecoder('gb18030', { fatal: true }).decode(data); encoding = 'GB18030'; }
        catch (_) { fail('未能识别文本编码，请另存为UTF-8文本，或直接粘贴简历内容。'); }
      }
    }
    return finish(value, /\.(md|markdown)$/i.test(file.name) ? 'Markdown' : 'TXT',
      '已在浏览器本地读取（' + encoding + '），请核对正文后再确认。');
  }

  function pageText(items) {
    const lines = [];
    let line = '';
    let lastY = null;
    let lastRight = null;
    for (const item of items) {
      if (typeof item.str !== 'string') continue;
      const y = item.transform && item.transform[5];
      const x = item.transform && item.transform[4];
      if (line && Number.isFinite(y) && Number.isFinite(lastY) && Math.abs(y - lastY) > 2) {
        lines.push(line); line = ''; lastRight = null;
      }
      const str = item.str;
      const gap = Number.isFinite(x) && Number.isFinite(lastRight) ? x - lastRight : 0;
      // Avoid splitting a Chinese phrase into spaced single characters.
      if (line && str && gap > 1 && /[A-Za-z0-9]$/.test(line) && /^[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(str)) line += ' ';
      line += str;
      lastY = y;
      lastRight = Number.isFinite(x) ? x + (Number(item.width) || 0) : null;
      if (item.hasEOL) { lines.push(line); line = ''; lastY = null; lastRight = null; }
    }
    if (line) lines.push(line);
    return cleanText(lines.join('\n'));
  }

  async function readPDF(file) {
    const pdfjs = await getPDF();
    const offlineReader=globalThis.CareerPathOfflineReader;
    let task;
    let pdf;
    try {
      task = pdfjs.getDocument({
        data: new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()),
        isEvalSupported: false,
        disableFontFace: true,
        useSystemFonts: true,
        useWorkerFetch: false,
        ...(offlineReader?.BinaryDataFactory ? {
          BinaryDataFactory: offlineReader.BinaryDataFactory,
          useWasm: false,
          isOffscreenCanvasSupported: false,
          isImageDecoderSupported: false
        } : {}),
        cMapUrl: new URL('vendor/cmaps/', baseURL).href,
        cMapPacked: true,
        standardFontDataUrl: new URL('vendor/standard_fonts/', baseURL).href
      });
      pdf = await task.promise;
      if (pdf.numPages > MAX_PAGES) fail('简历最多支持20页，请保留相关页面后重新导入。');
      const pages = [];
      let total = 0, photo = null;
      for (let i = 1; i <= pdf.numPages; i += 1) {
        const page = await pdf.getPage(i);
        const content = await page.getTextContent();
        const value = pageText(content.items);
        total += value.length;
        if (total > MAX_TEXT) fail('PDF文字过多，请只保留简历正文后重新导入。');
        pages.push(value);
        if(i===1&&globalThis.CareerJourneyResumePhoto)photo=await globalThis.CareerJourneyResumePhoto.extract(page,pdfjs);
        page.cleanup();
      }
      const value = pages.join('\n\n');
      if (value.replace(/\s/g, '').length < 20) {
        fail('未提取到足够的可用文字。文件可能是扫描件或文字层受限；本版不做图片识别，请粘贴简历文字。');
      }
      const result=finish(value, 'PDF', '已本地读取' + pdf.numPages + '页文字层；双栏、表格及项目顺序可能变化，请核对。');
      if(photo)result.photo=photo;
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error && error.name === 'PasswordException') fail('这份PDF设置了密码，请使用无密码版本或粘贴简历文字。');
      if (error && (error.name === 'InvalidPDFException' || error.name === 'MissingPDFException')) {
        fail('文件不是可读取的PDF，或文件已损坏。请换一个版本，或粘贴简历文字。');
      }
      throw error;
    } finally {
      if (pdf) await pdf.destroy().catch(function () {});
      else if (task) await task.destroy().catch(function () {});
    }
  }

  async function readDOCX(file) {
    const JSZip = await getZip();
    let zip;
    try { zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer()); }
    catch (_) { fail('无法读取DOCX文件，请确认它不是加密文件或旧版DOC格式，也可以直接粘贴文字。'); }
    const entry = zip.file('word/document.xml');
    if (!entry) fail('这个文件没有可读取的Word正文，请另存为DOCX或粘贴简历文字。');
    // Check the declared uncompressed XML size before expansion.
    if (entry._data && Number(entry._data.uncompressedSize) > MAX_DOC_XML) {
      fail('Word正文过大，请只保留简历内容后重新导入。');
    }
    const xml = await entry.async('string');
    if (xml.length > MAX_DOC_XML) fail('Word正文过大，请只保留简历内容后重新导入。');
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, 'application/xml');
    if (doc.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length) fail('Word正文格式异常，请另存文件或直接粘贴简历文字。');
    const body = doc.getElementsByTagNameNS('*', 'body')[0];
    if (!body) fail('没有找到Word正文，请换一个版本或粘贴简历文字。');
    // Paragraphs can contain further paragraphs inside text boxes. Enumerating
    // every paragraph and recursively reading each one duplicates their text.
    // Walk the body once, using paragraph boundaries only to separate lines.
    const parts = [];
    let lastCharacter = '';
    function append(value) {
      if (!value) return;
      parts.push(value);
      lastCharacter = value.slice(-1);
    }
    function paragraphBreak() {
      if (parts.length && lastCharacter !== '\n') append('\n');
    }
    function readNode(node) {
      if (node.nodeType !== 1) return;
      const isWord = /wordprocessingml/.test(node.namespaceURI || '');
      // Deleted or moved-away revisions are not part of the current document.
      if (isWord && (node.localName === 'del' || node.localName === 'moveFrom')) return;
      if (isWord && node.localName === 't') { append(node.textContent || ''); return; }
      if (isWord && node.localName === 'tab') { append('\t'); return; }
      if (isWord && (node.localName === 'br' || node.localName === 'cr')) { append('\n'); return; }
      const isParagraph = isWord && node.localName === 'p';
      if (isParagraph) paragraphBreak();
      for (const child of node.children) readNode(child);
      if (isParagraph) paragraphBreak();
    }
    readNode(body);
    return finish(parts.join(''), 'DOCX', '已在浏览器本地读取Word正文；图片、批注及页眉未导入，删除或移出的修订文字已跳过，请核对。');
  }

  async function readFile(file) {
    if (!file || typeof file.arrayBuffer !== 'function') fail('请先选择一份简历文件。');
    if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) fail('文件超过8MB，请压缩文件或直接粘贴简历文字。');
    if (!file.size) fail('文件是空的，请重新选择文件。');
    const name = String(file.name || '').toLowerCase();
    try {
      if (/\.(txt|md|markdown)$/.test(name)) return await readText(file);
      if (/\.pdf$/.test(name)) return await readPDF(file);
      if (/\.docx$/.test(name)) return await readDOCX(file);
      if (/\.doc$/.test(name)) fail('暂不支持旧版DOC，请另存为DOCX、PDF或文本，也可以直接粘贴文字。');
      fail('支持TXT、Markdown、文字版PDF和DOCX。请换一种格式，或直接粘贴简历文字。');
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error && error.message ? String(error.message) : '';
      if (/[\u4e00-\u9fff]/.test(message)) throw error;
      fail('简历读取未完成。请换一个文件，或将正文复制到输入框后继续。');
    }
  }

  globalThis.ResumeImporter = Object.freeze({
    supportedLabel: 'TXT / Markdown / PDF（文字版）/ DOCX，最大8MB、PDF不超过20页',
    readFile: readFile
  });
})();

</script>

          <g class="buddy-ears"><path d="M61 78C49 63 47 38 53 22C55 16 60 16 65 20C80 31 89 45 92 61Z" fill="#fffdf7" stroke="#c7deea" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M179 78C191 63 193 38 187 22C185 16 180 16 175 20C160 31 151 45 148 61Z" fill="#fffdf7" stroke="#c7deea" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M61 31C57 43 59 57 65 66L79 55C75 45 69 37 61 31Z" fill="#c6e9f8"/><path d="M179 31C183 43 181 57 175 66L161 55C165 45 171 37 179 31Z" fill="#c6e9f8"/></g>
          <path d="M50 88C49 61 70 45 94 46C104 46 109 49 120 49C132 49 136 46 146 46C170 45 191 61 190 88L185 107L198 104C190 125 174 139 155 145C141 151 131 158 120 160C109 158 99 151 85 145C66 139 50 125 42 104L55 107Z" fill="#fffdf7" stroke="#c7deea" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <path d="M68 79C84 62 106 58 120 59C134 58 156 62 172 79C160 75 149 78 140 87C134 94 128 99 120 102C112 99 106 94 100 87C91 78 80 75 68 79Z" fill="#edf7fc"/>
          <path d="M69 110C81 104 94 109 106 118C114 124 126 124 134 118C146 109 159 104 171 110C164 132 143 148 120 151C97 148 76 132 69 110Z" fill="#f3f9fc"/>
          <g class="buddy-eyes"><ellipse class="buddy-eye" cx="94" cy="98" rx="5.6" ry="8.2" fill="#294960"/><ellipse class="buddy-eye" cx="146" cy="98" rx="5.6" ry="8.2" fill="#294960"/><circle cx="96" cy="95" r="1.8" fill="white"/><circle cx="148" cy="95" r="1.8" fill="white"/></g>
          <g class="buddy-brows"><path d="M83 82C88 79 94 79 99 81M141 81C146 78 152 79 157 82" stroke="#7498b0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
          <ellipse cx="76" cy="115" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#f6ced1"/><ellipse cx="164" cy="115" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#f6ced1"/>
          <g class="buddy-muzzle"><path d="M115 113C117 110 123 110 125 113C126 116 122 120 120 120C118 120 114 116 115 113Z" fill="#36556c"/><path class="buddy-smile" d="M120 120V125M112 127C115 132 120 131 120 126C120 131 125 132 128 127" stroke="#617f94" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><ellipse class="buddy-speaking-mouth" cx="120" cy="130" rx="4.6" ry="4.3" fill="#536b83"/><path class="buddy-whiskers" d="M84 123L71 121M84 129L73 131M156 123L169 121M156 129L167 131" stroke="#c0d6e3" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
          <g class="buddy-glasses"><rect x="72" y="83" width="40" height="29" rx="12" stroke="#416986" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="128" y="83" width="40" height="29" rx="12" stroke="#416986" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M112 94C116 91 124 91 128 94M72 94L62 90M168 94L178 90" stroke="#416986" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M79 90L84 87M135 90L140 87" stroke="white" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
        </g>
        <g class="buddy-case"><rect x="45" y="187" width="32" height="42" rx="7" fill="#8fc7df"/><rect x="50" y="193" width="22" height="29" rx="3" fill="#f4fbff"/><path d="M55 201H66M55 207H66M55 213H62" stroke="#8fc1d8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M58 186V190M65 186V190" stroke="#5e95b3" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
      </g>
      <g class="buddy-spark"><path d="M30 85L33 92L40 95L33 98L30 105L27 98L20 95L27 92Z" fill="#9bd1e7"/><circle cx="211" cy="71" r="4" fill="#bcd9bb"/><path d="M207 60V54M204 57H210" stroke="#bcd9bb" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
    </svg></span>`;
  }

  function remove(node) {
    const timer = active.get(node);
    if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer);
    active.delete(node);
    node?.remove?.();
  }
  function clear() {
    for (const node of Array.from(active.keys())) remove(node);
    for (const timer of reactionTimers) clearTimeout(timer);
    reactionTimers.clear();
    for (const buddy of all('.career-buddy')) for (const name of reactions) buddy.classList?.remove(name);
  }
  function announce(text) {
    const node = find('#demo-motion-live');
    if (node) node.textContent = text;
  }
  function syncPreference() {
    const off = paused || reduced();
    doc?.documentElement?.classList?.toggle('demo-motion-off', off);
    for (const button of all('[data-motion-toggle]')) {
      button.textContent = reduced() ? '动态：减弱' : paused ? '动态：关' : '动态：开';
      button.setAttribute?.('aria-pressed', String(off));
      button.disabled = reduced();
      button.title = reduced() ? '跟随系统的减少动态效果设置' : '暂停或开启角色与过关动画';
    }
    if (off) clear();
  }
  function addElement(className, text = '', lifetime = 1400) {
    const layer = find('#demo-fx-layer');
    if (!enabled() || !layer || !doc?.createElement) return null;
    while (active.size >= MAX_ELEMENTS) remove(active.keys().next().value);
    const node = doc.createElement('span');
    node.className = className;
    node.textContent = text;
    node.setAttribute?.('aria-hidden', 'true');
    layer.append(node);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => remove(node), lifetime);
    active.set(node, timer);
    return node;
  }
  function reaction(kind) {
    if (!enabled()) return;
    const className = kind === 'cheer' ? 'buddy-react-cheer' : kind === 'think' ? 'buddy-react-think' : 'buddy-react-wave';
    for (const buddy of all('.career-buddy')) buddy.classList?.add(className);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      reactionTimers.delete(timer);
      for (const buddy of all('.career-buddy')) buddy.classList?.remove(className);
    }, 1050);
    reactionTimers.add(timer);
  }
  function confetti(count = 12) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const node = addElement('demo-fx-piece demo-fx-piece--' + (i % 3));
      if (!node) break;
      node.style?.setProperty('--fx-x', `${((i * 19) % 77) - 38}vw`);
      node.style?.setProperty('--fx-rise', `${-45 - (i % 4) * 18}px`);
      node.style?.setProperty('--fx-rotate', `${(i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * (140 + i * 27)}deg`);
      node.style?.setProperty('--fx-delay', `${(i % 4) * 22}ms`);
      node.style?.setProperty('--fx-colour', colours[i % colours.length]);
    }
  }
  function paper() {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const node = addElement('demo-fx-paper', '', 1100);
      node?.style?.setProperty('--paper-index', String(i));
    }
  }
  function onAction(type, details = {}) {
    // Each action replaces the previous burst. Rapid clicks cannot accumulate
    // unbounded DOM nodes or delayed celebrations from earlier questions.
    clear();
    if (type === 'RESET') { announce('已回到起点，随时再出发。'); return; }
    const xp = Number(details.xp), previous = Number(details.previousXp);
    const delta = Number.isFinite(xp) && Number.isFinite(previous) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, xp - previous)) : 0;
    const messages = {
      LOAD_RESUME: '示例简历准备好了，向下一站出发！',
      START_DISCOVERY: '先聊聊你在意的工作方式，答案不分好坏。',
      NEXT_DISCOVERY: '继续看一段具体经历，区分偏好、顾虑和已经验证的能力。',
      FINISH_DISCOVERY: '职业探索已完成，去看看每个方向的依据与待验证之处。',
      CONFIRM_RESUME: details.step === 'preferences' ? '资料已确认，先填写当前求职意向和准备时间。' : details.step === 'discovery' ? '简历已确认，先了解动力、偏好与现实条件。' : '资料已确认，去看看两组岗位方向。',
      SELECT_ROLE: '岗位方向选好啦，学习地图已经展开。',
      SELECT_ROUTE: '路线选好啦，开始这一段练习。',
      SUBMIT_TRAINING: '已完成一次练习记录，看看具体反馈。',
      SUBMIT_INTERVIEW: '这一轮问答已完成，继续完善表达。',
      OPEN_LESSON: '小关卡开始啦。先动手试一试，再看反馈。',
      NEXT_LESSON: '向下一小步出发，也可以随时回地图复习。',
      OPEN_INTERVIEW: '来到面试小岛，看看怎样讲清经历与练习。',
      BACK_MAP: '已回到关卡地图，练习记录为你保留。',
      COMPLETE_LESSON: '这一关完成啦，新关卡已解锁。',
      CHECK_ANSWER: details.correct === true ? '这一步做对啦！看看为什么。' : '还差一点。根据提示再试一次。',
      BUDDY_GREET: '你好呀，我是Milo！准备好就一起向下一站出发。'
    };
    let text = messages[type] || '';
    const finish = (type === 'NEXT_INTERVIEW' || type === 'COMPLETE_INTERVIEW') && details.finished === true;
    const unlocked = type === 'NEXT_TRAINING' && details.step === 'interview';
    if (finish) text = '这一段求职演示走完啦！';
    else if (unlocked) text = '培训旅程已完成，面试关卡解锁。';
    if (!text) return;
    if (details.product === true) {
      const productMessages={LOAD_RESUME:'简历已经整理好，先核对一下，再继续准备。',SELECT_ROLE:'方向选好，从关键任务开始准备。',NEXT_LESSON:details.step==='interview'?'岗位训练完成，来一轮面试吧。':'继续下一项任务。'};
      text=productMessages[type]||text.replace(/示例简历/g,'简历').replace(/求职演示/g,'面试准备').replace(/演示/g,'准备');
    }
    const award = delta && !(type === 'CHECK_ANSWER' && details.correct !== true);
    announce(text + (award ? ` 增加${delta}演示XP；积分只表示演示进度。` : ''));
    if (!enabled()) return;
    if (award) addElement('demo-xp-pop', `+${delta} 演示 XP`, 1250);
    if (type === 'BUDDY_GREET') reaction('wave');
    else if (type === 'LOAD_RESUME') { reaction('wave'); paper(); }
    else if (finish || unlocked) { reaction('cheer'); confetti(finish ? 16 : 10); }
    else if (type === 'SELECT_ROUTE' || type === 'SELECT_ROLE') { reaction('cheer'); confetti(6); }
    else if (type === 'COMPLETE_LESSON') { reaction('cheer'); confetti(10); }
    else if (type === 'CHECK_ANSWER' && details.correct === true) { reaction('cheer'); confetti(5); }
    else reaction('think');
  }

  doc?.addEventListener?.('click', event => {
    if (event.target?.closest?.('[data-demo-action="RESET"]')) {
      clear();
      announce('已回到起点，随时再出发。');
      return;
    }
    const toggle = event.target?.closest?.('[data-motion-toggle]');
    if (!toggle || reduced()) return;
    paused = !paused;
    syncPreference();
    announce(paused ? '动态效果已暂停，页面仍可正常使用。' : '动态效果已开启。');
  });
  const mediaChanged = () => { syncPreference(); };
  if (typeof media?.addEventListener === 'function') media.addEventListener('change', mediaChanged);
  else media?.addListener?.(mediaChanged);
  syncPreference();
  globalThis.CareerDemoMotion = Object.freeze({mascotMarkup, onAction,
    status: () => Object.freeze({enabled: enabled(), paused, reduced: reduced(), activeElements: active.size})});
})();

</script>
<script>
/* Career preparation workspace views. The controller owns transitions and saved state. */
(() => {

  function hero(ctx, {label, title, description, number, unit, note, tags = []}) {

  }

  function paths(ctx) {

      <div class="j-path-cards ws-path-grid">

        <article class="j-path-card ws-path-card is-white"><div class="ws-card-top"><span class="j-path-letter ws-path-letter">B</span><span class="ws-route-chip">面向求职意向</span></div><span class="j-role-icon ws-role-icon">${icon('chart')}</span><h2>准备我想去的方向</h2><p>${preferenceModule?(hasIntended?'只围绕你填写的意向，查看对应学习计划，逐步补上目前缺少的能力。':'当前意向还没有对应的训练路线。可以先查看经历推荐，或修改求职意向。'):'写下意向岗位和求职日期，从学习计划开始，逐步补上目前缺少的能力。'}</p><div class="ws-path-flow"><span>${preferenceModule?`${intended.length} 个对应方向`:'选定目标岗位'}</span>${icon('arrow')}<span>学习计划</span>${icon('arrow')}<span>训练与面试</span></div><div class="ws-card-footer">${btn(preferenceModule?'查看意向学习计划 →':'填写意向，制定计划 →','CHOOSE_B',hasIntended?'':'disabled aria-disabled="true"')}${preferenceModule&&!hasIntended?btn('修改求职意向','EDIT_CAREER_PREFERENCES','','secondary'):''}</div></article>
      </div><div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn('回看我的简历','SHOW_RESUME','','ghost')}${preferenceModule&&hasIntended?btn('修改求职意向','EDIT_CAREER_PREFERENCES','','ghost'):''}</div>
    </section>`;
  }

  function intent(ctx) {
    const {state, D, h, icon, btn, addDays} = ctx;
    const preferenceModule=globalThis.CareerJourneyPreferences;
    const preferences=preferenceModule?.normalize(state.careerPreferences);
    const intended=preferenceModule?preferenceModule.supportedRoles(preferences,D.rolesB):D.rolesB;
    if(preferenceModule&&!intended.length)return `<section class="j-screen ws-page ws-intent"><h1>先确认你想去的方向</h1><p class="ws-description">当前意向还没有对应的训练路线，可以修改意向，或先看已有经历支持的岗位。</p><div class="j-actions">${btn('修改求职意向','EDIT_CAREER_PREFERENCES')}${btn('返回准备方式','GO_PATHS','','secondary')}</div></section>`;
    if(preferenceModule&&preferences&&!state.roleId){
      return `<section class="j-screen ws-screen ws-page ws-intent ws-intended-roles">
        ${hero(ctx,{label:'已选求职方向',title:'你想先准备哪个岗位？',description:`准备到 ${preferences.deadline}，每周投入 ${preferences.hoursPerWeek} 小时。选择后直接展开对应学习计划。`,number:String(intended.length).padStart(2,'0'),unit:'个意向方向',note:{label:'来自你填写的意向',text:preferences.goals.join('、')},tags:preferences.goals})}
        <div class="j-role-grid ws-card-grid">${intended.map((item,index)=>`<article class="j-role-card ws-role-card"><div class="ws-card-top"><span class="ws-card-index">0${index+1}</span><span class="ws-route-chip">你的求职意向</span></div><span class="j-role-icon ws-role-icon">${icon('case')}</span><h2>${h(item.title)}</h2><p class="j-role-rationale ws-role-copy">${h(item.rationale||'按你确认的目标，安排对应的学习与面试准备。')}</p>${item.strengths?.[0]||item.risks?.[0]?`<div class="j-role-glance ws-role-evidence">${item.strengths?.[0]?`<div class="ws-evidence-item"><span class="ws-evidence-dot"></span><div><strong>可以发挥的优势</strong><p>${h(item.strengths[0])}</p></div></div>`:''}${item.risks?.[0]?`<div class="ws-evidence-item is-challenge"><span class="ws-evidence-dot"></span><div><strong>需要提前准备</strong><p>${h(item.risks[0])}</p></div></div>`:''}</div>`:''}<div class="ws-card-footer">${btn('先准备这个方向 →','START_INTENDED_ROLE',`data-role-id="${h(item.id)}"`)}</div></article>`).join('')}</div>
        <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn('修改求职意向','EDIT_CAREER_PREFERENCES','','secondary')}${btn('返回准备方式','GO_PATHS','','ghost')}</div>
      </section>`;
    }
    const start = typeof ctx.today === 'function' ? ctx.today() : ctx.today;
    const preferred=D.defaults?.deadline;
    const legacyDeadline=preferred&&preferred>start&&preferred<=addDays(start,366)?preferred:addDays(start,84);
    const end = state.intent.deadline || preferences?.deadline || (preferenceModule?'':legacyDeadline);
    const candidates=[ctx.M?.roleFor(state.roleId)?.title,state.intent.goal,...(preferenceModule?intended.map(item=>item.title):[state.profile.goal])];
    const selectedGoal=candidates.find(goal=>intended.some(item=>item.title===goal))||'';
    const hasIntent=Boolean(state.intent.goal||state.intent.deadline||state.roleId);
    const hours=preferenceModule?(state.intent.deadline?state.intent.hoursPerWeek:preferences?.hoursPerWeek)||'':(hasIntent?state.intent.hoursPerWeek:preferences?.hoursPerWeek)||state.intent.hoursPerWeek||6;
    const editingTarget=Boolean(state.roleId&&state.branch==='B');
    if(preferenceModule){
      return `<section class="j-screen j-intent-screen ws-screen ws-page ws-intent rt-planner" aria-labelledby="rt-intent-title">
        <header class="rt-planner-head"><p class="ws-kicker">${selectedGoal?h(selectedGoal)+' · ':''}求职准备</p><h1 id="rt-intent-title">每周能学多久？</h1><p>选一个自己能坚持的节奏。</p></header>
        <form id="j-intent-form" class="j-card rt-planner-card">
          <label class="j-field rt-goal-field"><span>意向岗位</span><select id="j-goal" required><option value="" disabled ${selectedGoal?'':'selected'}>请选择一个目标岗位</option>${intended.map(item=>`<option value="${h(item.title)}" ${item.title===selectedGoal?'selected':''}>${h(item.title)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
          ${preferenceModule.timeFields({hoursId:'j-hours',deadlineId:'j-deadline',hours,deadline:end,min:addDays(start,1),max:addDays(start,366),h})}
          ${state.error?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(state.error)}</p>`:''}
          <div class="j-actions rt-planner-actions">${btn(editingTarget?'更新学习计划 →':'生成学习计划 →','SAVE_INTENT')}${editingTarget?btn('返回当前学习计划','SHOW_PLAN','','ghost small'):btn('返回准备方式','GO_PATHS','','ghost small')}</div>
        </form>
      </section>`;
    }
    return `<section class="j-screen j-intent-screen ws-screen ws-page ws-intent">
      ${hero(ctx, {label:'目标岗位', title:editingTarget?'选择或调整你的意向岗位。':'你想准备哪个岗位？', description:editingTarget?'在下方选择目标岗位，也可以修改求职日期与每周投入；保存后直接更新学习计划。':'先确定方向和时间，学习计划才能落到每一周。', number:'03', unit:'项信息', note:{label:'计划从这里开始', text:'意向岗位、求职日期与每周时间，会共同决定准备节奏。'}, tags:['目标岗位','求职日期','每周投入']})}
      <div class="ws-intent-layout"><form id="j-intent-form" class="j-card ws-form"><div class="ws-form-heading"><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('calendar')}</span><div><p class="ws-kicker">安排学习时间</p><h2>为目标留出时间</h2></div></div>
        <label class="j-field"><span>意向岗位${preferenceModule?' · 来自你填写的意向':''}</span><select id="j-goal"><option value="" disabled ${selectedGoal?'':'selected'}>请选择一个目标岗位</option>${intended.map(item => `<option value="${h(item.title)}" ${item.title === selectedGoal ? 'selected' : ''}>${h(item.title)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
        <label class="j-field"><span>希望最晚什么时候做好求职准备？</span><input type="date" id="j-deadline" min="${addDays(start,1)}" max="${addDays(start,366)}" value="${h(end)}" required></label>
        <div class="j-field"><label for="j-hours">每周可以投入多少小时？</label><div class="j-input-unit"><input id="j-hours" type="number" min="1" max="40" step="any" value="${hours}" required><span>小时 / 周</span></div></div>
        ${editingTarget?'<p class="ws-stat-note">修改时间安排会保留记录；更换岗位会重新安排对应课程与面试。</p>':''}${state.error ? `<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(state.error)}</p>` : ''}<div class="j-actions">${btn(editingTarget?'保存选择，更新学习计划 →':'生成我的学习计划 →','SAVE_INTENT')}${editingTarget?btn('返回当前学习计划','SHOW_PLAN','','secondary'):''}${btn(editingTarget?'切换准备方式':'返回选择','GO_PATHS','','ghost')}${preferenceModule?btn('修改求职意向','EDIT_CAREER_PREFERENCES','','ghost'):''}</div>
      </form><aside class="ws-intent-aside ws-blue-card"><p class="ws-kicker">我的学习计划</p><h2>把目标，<br>排进日历。</h2><div class="ws-intent-symbol" aria-hidden="true">${icon('calendar')}</div><ol class="ws-intent-checklist"><li><b>01</b><div><strong>先选想去的方向</strong><p>在这里选定一个目标，下一步直接生成它的学习计划。</p></div></li><li><b>02</b><div><strong>再看可用的时间</strong><p>近期求职先抓重点，较长周期逐步加入作品练习。</p></div></li><li><b>03</b><div><strong>留下可以检查的产出</strong><p>计划包含阶段任务、每周安排与复盘重点。</p></div></li></ol></aside></div>
    </section>`;
  }

  function roles(ctx) {
    const {state, D, h, icon, btn} = ctx;
    if(state.branch==='B')return intent(ctx);
    const items = state.branch === 'A' ? D.rolesA : [...D.rolesB].sort((a,b) => Number(b.title === state.intent.goal) - Number(a.title === state.intent.goal));
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-screen ws-page ws-roles">
      ${hero(ctx, {label:state.branch === 'A' ? '从已有经历出发' : '围绕求职意向', title:state.branch === 'A' ? '从你的经历，找到可以切入的工作。' : `围绕「${state.intent.goal}」的三个方向`, description:state.branch === 'A' ? '这里看的是经历如何迁移，以及真正上岗前还要补什么。' : `计划在 ${state.intent.deadline} 开始求职；先选一个方向，再展开对应的学习计划。`, number:String(items.length).padStart(2,'0'), unit:'个方向', note:{label:state.branch === 'A' ? 'A · 经历推荐' : 'B · 意向发展', text:state.branch === 'A' ? '比较能发挥的优势与需要准备的部分，再选值得深入的岗位。' : `每周计划投入 ${state.intent.hoursPerWeek} 小时，具体安排将在选定岗位后展开。`}, tags:['岗位任务','优势与挑战','由你决定']})}
      <div class="j-role-grid ws-card-grid">${items.map((item,index) => `<article class="j-role-card ws-role-card"><div class="ws-card-top"><span class="ws-card-index">0${index+1}</span><span class="ws-route-chip">${item.route === 'A' ? '经历迁移' : '意向发展'}</span></div><span class="j-role-icon ws-role-icon">${icon(item.route === 'A' ? 'case' : 'chart')}</span><h2>${h(item.title)}</h2><p class="j-role-rationale ws-role-copy">${h(item.rationale)}</p><div class="j-role-glance ws-role-evidence"><div class="ws-evidence-item"><span class="ws-evidence-dot"></span><div><strong>可以发挥的优势</strong><p>${h(item.strengths[0])}</p></div></div><div class="ws-evidence-item is-challenge"><span class="ws-evidence-dot"></span><div><strong>需要提前准备</strong><p>${h(item.risks[0])}</p></div></div></div><div class="ws-card-footer">${btn('了解这个岗位 →','OPEN_ROLE',`data-role-id="${h(item.id)}"`)}</div></article>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn('换一种准备方式','GO_PATHS','','ghost')}</div>
    </section>`;
  }

  function role(ctx) {
    const {state, M, h, icon, btn} = ctx;
    const item = M.roleFor(state.previewRoleId);
    if (!item) return `<section class="j-screen ws-page"><h1>先选择一个岗位方向</h1>${btn('返回三个推荐方向','BACK_ROLES')}</section>`;
    return `<section class="j-screen j-role-detail ws-screen ws-page ws-role">
      <div class="ws-back-row">${btn('← 返回三个推荐方向','BACK_ROLES','','ghost small')}</div>
      ${hero(ctx, {label:'LOOK AT THE REAL WORK', title:item.title, description:'先过一遍这个岗位的三个关键工作，再开始动手练习。', number:String(item.focus.length).padStart(2,'0'), unit:'项重点', note:{label:'岗位准备，从真实任务开始', text:item.route === 'A' ? '把已有协作经验练成更可靠的岗位动作。' : '先制定学习计划，再用具体练习检验学习进展。'}, tags:[item.route === 'A' ? '已有经历支持' : '面向发展意向','任务 · 依据 · 交接']})}
      <div class="j-focus-list ws-focus-grid">${item.focus.map((text,index) => `<article class="j-card ws-focus-card"><div class="ws-stage-top"><b class="ws-focus-number">0${index+1}</b><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon(index === 0 ? 'case' : index === 1 ? 'chart' : 'check')}</span></div><h3>${h(text)}</h3></article>`).join('')}</div>
      <details class="j-details j-card ws-tradeoffs"><summary>看看这个方向的优势与挑战</summary><div class="j-grid two ws-tradeoff-grid"><div><p class="ws-kicker">YOUR STARTING POINT</p><h3>你的起点</h3><ul>${item.strengths.map(text => `<li>${h(text)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div><div><p class="ws-kicker">WHAT TO PREPARE</p><h3>需要补足</h3><ul>${item.risks.map(text => `<li>${h(text)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div></div></details>
      <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn(state.onboardingComplete?(item.route === 'A'?'开始岗位任务训练 →':'展开我的学习计划 →'):'确认这个方向，返回首页 →','CHOOSE_ROLE',`data-role-id="${h(item.id)}"`)}${btn('再比较其他方向','BACK_ROLES','','secondary')}</div>
    </section>`;
  }

  function plan(ctx) {
    const {state, M, h, icon, btn, addDays} = ctx;
    const value = M.planFor(state), item = ctx.role || M.roleFor(state.roleId);
    if (!value || !item) return `<section class="j-screen ws-page"><h1>先补充求职意向</h1>${btn('修改意向与时间','EDIT_INTENT')}</section>`;
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-screen ws-page ws-plan">
      ${hero(ctx, {label:'A PLAN YOU CAN FOLLOW', title:`${item.title} · 我的学习计划`, description:value.summary, number:String(value.weeks).padStart(2,'0'), unit:'周计划', note:{label:'本轮学习周期', text:`约 ${value.totalHours} 小时，按每周最多 ${value.hoursPerWeek} 小时排期。这是学习安排，不是已完成时长。`}, tags:[`${value.stages.length} 个阶段`,`${value.calendar.length} 份每周安排`,'产出与复盘同步']})}
      <div class="j-plan-summary ws-plan-metrics"><article><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('calendar')}</span><div><small>建议学习周期</small><strong>${value.weeks}周</strong></div></article><article><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('book')}</span><div><small>每周安排</small><strong>${value.hoursPerWeek}小时</strong></div></article><article><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('case')}</span><div><small>预计完成日期</small><strong>${h(addDays(state.intent.today,value.days-1))}</strong></div></article></div>
      <article class="ws-panel ws-plan-fit ${value.deadlineFeasible===false?'is-tight':'is-feasible'}"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>${value.deadlineFeasible===false?'当前投入需要更长排期':'学习节奏与求职时间'}</h2><span class="ws-route-chip">目标求职日 ${h(state.intent.deadline)}</span></div><p>${h(value.deadlineSummary||(value.deadlineFeasible===false?`完整计划还差约 ${value.shortfallHours} 小时，建议增加每周投入，或把排期延长约 ${value.extraDaysNeeded} 天。`:'按当前投入完成完整练习后，仍可留出求职准备时间。'))}</p>${value.deadlineFeasible===false?btn('修改意向与时间','EDIT_INTENT','','secondary'):''}<p class="ws-stat-note">${h(value.workloadBasis||'练习工时为规划估计，实际进度以知识、练习和复盘记录为准。')}</p></article>
      <div class="j-plan-timeline ws-stage-grid">${value.stages.map((stage,index) => `<article class="j-plan-milestone ws-stage-card"><div class="ws-stage-top"><span class="j-week-number ws-stage-number">0${index+1}</span><span class="ws-stage-date">第${stage.startDay}—${stage.endDay}天</span></div><h2>${h(stage.title)}</h2><p>${h(stage.goal)}</p><div class="ws-stage-output">${icon('check')}<div><span>阶段产出</span><strong>${h(stage.deliverable)}</strong></div></div></article>`).join('')}</div>
      <details class="j-details j-card ws-weekly"><summary>查看每周任务表 · ${value.weeks}周</summary><div class="j-plan-weeks ws-week-grid">${value.calendar.map(week => `<article class="j-plan-week ws-week-card"><div class="ws-stage-top"><span class="ws-route-chip">第${week.week}周</span><span class="ws-stage-date">${h(addDays(state.intent.today,week.startDay-1))}—${h(addDays(state.intent.today,week.endDay-1))}</span></div><h3>${h(week.title)}</h3><p>${h(week.task)}</p><div class="ws-week-deliverable"><strong>交付：</strong>${h(week.deliverable)}</div><div class="ws-week-review"><strong>复盘：</strong>${h(week.review)}</div><small>计划投入 ${week.estimatedHours} 小时</small></article>`).join('')}</div></details>
      <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn(ctx.completed.length?(state.interview.finished?'复习岗位训练 →':'继续岗位训练 →'):'从第一项知识开始学 →','START_LEARNING')}${btn(state.interview.finished?'再练一轮模拟面试':'先做一次模拟面试',state.interview.finished?'OPEN_INTERVIEW_PRACTICE':'START_INTERVIEW','','secondary')}${btn('下载学习计划表','DOWNLOAD_PLAN','','secondary')}${state.interview.finished?btn('回到准备报告','BACK_FINISH','','secondary'):''}${btn('修改意向与时间','EDIT_INTENT','','ghost')}</div>
    </section>`;
  }

  globalThis.CareerJourneyWorkspaceViews = Object.freeze({paths, intent, roles, role, plan});
})();

</script>
<script>
/* Guided home and import views. The controller owns progress and every action. */
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const stepCopy = [
    {title:'上传简历', description:'让准备，从你的真实经历开始。', icon:'upload', entry:'上传我的简历'},
    {title:'核对个人资料', description:'优化简历表达，补充当前求职意向。', icon:'file', entry:'核对我的资料'},
    {title:'选择岗位方向', description:'比较已有优势和心仪方向。', icon:'case', entry:'选择准备方向'},
    {title:'岗位学习', description:'跟着任务，一项项练好能力。', icon:'book', entry:'开始岗位学习'},
    {title:'模拟面试', description:'练习回答与追问，留下复盘。', icon:'chat', entry:'进入模拟面试'}
  ];
  const lock = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="5" y="10" width="14" height="11" rx="3"/><path d="M8 10V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3m-4 5v2"/></svg>';
  const safeNumber = value => Number.isFinite(Number(value)) ? Math.max(0,Number(value)) : 0;
  const weekdays=['周日','周一','周二','周三','周四','周五','周六'];
  const ribbonColors=['#78943c','#d8a63c','#648b49','#e5bf52','#93ab55'];
  const ribbonFlight=[[-46,-20],[-44,-42],[-32,-53],[-24,-39],[-10,-57],[0,-46],[10,-56],[24,-43],[35,-50],[44,-34],[47,-16],[31,-13]];

  function checkInBurst() {
    return '<span class="gh-checkin-burst" aria-hidden="true"><span class="gh-checkin-pulse"></span>'+
      ribbonFlight.map(([x,y],i)=>`<b style="--gh-ribbon-x:${x}px;--gh-ribbon-y:${y}px;--gh-ribbon-spin:${(i%2?1:-1)*(138+i*19)}deg;--gh-ribbon-color:${ribbonColors[i%ribbonColors.length]};--gh-ribbon-delay:${(i%3)*14}ms"></b>`).join('')+
      '</span>';
  }

  function stepsFor(ctx) {
    const steps = ctx.M.onboardingSteps(ctx.state);
    return stepCopy.map((copy,index) => ({...copy,id:index+1,status:steps.find(step => step.id===index+1)?.status || 'locked',skipped:steps.find(step=>step.id===index+1)?.skipped===true}));
  }

  function home(ctx) {
    if (ctx.state.onboardingComplete || (ctx.state.interview?.finished && ctx.state.confirmed && ctx.M.roleFor(ctx.state.roleId))) return dashboard(ctx);
    const {state,h,icon,btn} = ctx, steps = stepsFor(ctx);
    const done = steps.filter(step=>step.status==='done'&&!step.skipped).length;
    const current = steps.find(step=>step.status==='current');
    const allDone = done===steps.length;
    const canInterview=ctx.M.canInterview?.(state) ?? Boolean(state.profile&&state.confirmed&&ctx.M.roleFor(state.roleId));
    return `<section class="j-screen gh-home gh-guided-home" aria-labelledby="gh-home-title">
      <div class="gh-intro-grid"><header class="gh-intro gh-blue-panel"><p class="gh-kicker">下一步</p><h1 id="gh-home-title">${allDone?'五步走完，准备向前。':done?'下一步，继续点亮。':'从第一步，开始你的求职准备。'}</h1><p>${allDone?'简历、方向、学习和面试都已就位。打开工作台，随时继续完善。':canInterview?'可以先学岗位知识，也可以先做面试，再按复盘补学。':'每次只做好一件事。完成后回到这里，再开启下一步。'}</p><div class="gh-current-hint">${icon(allDone?'check':current?.icon||'arrow')}<span>${allDone?'你的工作台已经准备好了':`现在请点击 ${String(current?.id||1).padStart(2,'0')} · ${h(current?.title||stepCopy[0].title)}`}</span></div>${allDone?`<div class="gh-unlock-action">${btn('打开我的工作台 →','COMPLETE_ONBOARDING')}</div>`:canInterview?`<div class="gh-unlock-action gh-direct-interview">${btn(state.interview?.answers?.length?'继续模拟面试':'先做一次模拟面试','START_INTERVIEW','','secondary')}<span>学习可以稍后继续，面试不需要等待。</span></div>`:''}</header>
      <aside class="gh-completion" aria-label="五步准备进度"><p>已完成</p><div class="gh-completion-number"><strong>${done}</strong><span>/ 5 步</span></div><div class="gh-five-markers" aria-hidden="true">${steps.map(step=>`<span class="is-${step.skipped?'skipped':step.status}"></span>`).join('')}</div><p class="gh-completion-note">${state.profile?'按自己的节奏，完成一步，点亮一步。':'现在只需一份简历。其余信息，接下来逐步补充。'}</p></aside></div>
      <div class="gh-steps-heading"><h2>你的五步准备</h2><p>${allDone?'每一步都可以回来复看。':'亮起的一步，就是现在的起点。'}</p></div>
      <ol class="gh-step-grid" aria-label="求职准备五步骤">${steps.map(step=>`<li><button type="button" class="gh-step is-${step.status} ${step.skipped?'is-skipped':''}" data-j-action="OPEN_ONBOARDING_STEP" data-index="${step.id}" ${step.status==='locked'?'disabled aria-disabled="true"':step.status==='current'?'aria-current="step"':''} aria-label="第${step.id}步，${h(step.title)}，${step.skipped?'稍后补学':step.status==='done'?'已完成，可复看':step.status==='locked'?'待解锁':'当前步骤'}"><span class="gh-step-top"><span class="gh-step-number">${String(step.id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="gh-step-mark">${step.skipped?icon('book'):step.status==='done'?icon('check'):step.status==='locked'?lock:icon(step.icon)}</span></span><span class="gh-step-title">${h(step.title)}</span><span class="gh-step-description">${h(step.description)}</span><span class="gh-step-entry">${h(step.skipped?'稍后补学，随时回来':step.status==='done'?'回看这一步':step.status==='locked'?'完成上一步后开启':step.entry)}${step.status==='locked'?'':icon('arrow')}</span></button></li>`).join('')}</ol>
    </section>`;
  }

  function daysFor(ctx) {
    const supplied = typeof ctx.today === 'function' ? ctx.today() : ctx.today;
    const localNow = new Date();
    localNow.setMinutes(localNow.getMinutes()-localNow.getTimezoneOffset());
    const stamp = Date.parse(supplied+'T00:00:00Z');
    const end = Number.isFinite(stamp)?stamp:Date.parse(localNow.toISOString().slice(0,10)+'T00:00:00Z');
    const dates = new Set(Array.isArray(ctx.checkInDates)?ctx.checkInDates:[]);
    return Array.from({length:7},(_,index)=>{
      const date=new Date(end-(6-index)*86400000);
      const day=date.toISOString().slice(0,10);
      return {day,weekday:weekdays[date.getUTCDay()],today:index===6,done:dates.has(day)};
    });
  }

  function planDays(week) {
    if(!week.startDate||!week.activities?.length)return [];
    const count=week.endDay-week.startDay+1;
    const stamp=Date.parse(week.startDate+'T00:00:00Z');
    let units=0;
    const intervals=week.activities.map((item,index)=>{
      const start=units;
      units+=Math.round(item.estimatedHours*100);
      return {task:item.task,number:index+1,start,end:units};
    });
    return Array.from({length:count},(_,index)=>{
      const date=new Date(stamp+index*86400000),iso=date.toISOString().slice(0,10);
      const from=Math.floor(index*units/count),to=Math.floor((index+1)*units/count);
      const tasks=to>from?intervals.filter(item=>item.start<to&&item.end>from):[];
      return {today:iso===week.today,weekday:weekdays[date.getUTCDay()],date:iso.slice(5).replace('-','/'),hours:(to-from)/100,tasks};
    });
  }

  function weeklyPlan(ctx,week) {
    const {h}=ctx;
    const activities=week.activities?.length?`<ol class="gh-week-activities" aria-label="本周学习安排">${week.activities.map((item,index)=>`<li><span class="gh-week-task-number">${index+1}</span><span>${item.startedBeforeWeek?'继续 · ':''}${h(item.task)}</span><span>${safeNumber(item.estimatedHours)} 小时</span></li>`).join('')}</ol>`:`<p>${h(week.task)}</p>`;
    const days=planDays(week);
    const schedule=days.length?`<ol class="gh-plan-calendar" aria-label="本周每日学习建议">${days.map(day=>{
      const task=day.tasks.map(item=>item.task).join('；'), taskNumbers=day.tasks.map(item=>item.number);
      return `<li class="${day.today?'is-today':''}"${day.today?' aria-current="date"':''}><span class="gh-plan-day-label">${day.today?'今天':day.weekday} <small>${h(day.date)}</small></span><strong>${day.hours?day.hours+' 小时':'机动'}</strong><span class="gh-plan-day-task"${task?` title="${h(task)}" aria-label="${h(task)}"`:''}>${task?'任务 '+taskNumbers.join('、'):'复习或休息'}</span></li>`;
    }).join('')}</ol>`:'';
    return `<div class="gh-current-plan"><div><span>第 ${week.week} 周${week.dates?' · '+h(week.dates):''}</span><strong>${h(week.title)}</strong></div>${activities}<span>本周交付：${h(week.deliverable)}</span>${schedule}</div>`;
  }

  function interviewPractice(ctx,report) {
    if (!report) return '';
    const {state,M,h,icon}=ctx;
    const previous=M.reportState(state,report.id);
    const index=previous.interview.answers.length-1;
    const nextTry=index>=0?M.roundFor(previous,index)?.feedback.nextTry:'';
    if (!nextTry) return '';
    const current=state.interview.finished && report.current;
    return `<button class="gh-review-practice" type="button" data-j-action="${current?'REVIEW_INTERVIEW':'VIEW_REPORT'}" ${current?`data-index="${index}"`:`data-report-id="${h(report.id)}"`}><span class="gh-review-practice-icon">${icon('chat')}</span><span><span>面试复盘 · 下次练习</span><strong>${h(nextTry)}</strong></span>${icon('arrow')}</button>`;
  }

  function checkInCard(ctx,days,weekCount) {
    const {h,icon}=ctx;
    const checked=days.at(-1).done;
    const newCheck=checked && days.at(-1).day===ctx.checkInCelebrationDate;
    const calendar=days.map(day=>`<div class="gh-day ${day.done?'is-done':''} ${day.today?'is-today':''}${newCheck&&day.today?' is-celebrating':''}" title="${h(day.day)}" aria-label="${h(day.day)}${day.today?'，今天':''}，${day.done?'已打卡':'未打卡'}"><span>${day.today?'今天':day.weekday}</span><i>${day.done?icon('check'):''}${newCheck&&day.today?checkInBurst():''}</i></div>`).join('');
    return `<article class="gh-module gh-learning gh-checkin-monitor${newCheck?' is-celebrating':''}"><div class="gh-module-heading"><span class="gh-module-label">学习与打卡</span><span class="gh-plan-badge">近七天 ${weekCount} 天</span></div><h2>${checked?'今天，也在向前。':'给今天，留一个脚印。'}</h2><p class="gh-streak-line">连续打卡 <strong>${safeNumber(ctx.streak)}</strong> 天</p><div class="gh-week" aria-label="近七天学习打卡">${calendar}</div><p class="gh-checkin-explanation">完成学习任务会记录当天，也可以手动打卡。</p><div class="gh-learning-actions"><button type="button" class="j-btn ${checked?'secondary':'primary'} small" data-j-action="DAILY_CHECK_IN" ${checked?'disabled':''}>${checked?'今日已打卡':'今日打卡'}</button><button type="button" class="gh-text-link" data-j-action="SHOW_LEARNING_RECORDS">学习记录${icon('arrow')}</button></div></article>`;
  }

  function planWindow(ctx,plan) {
    if(!plan?.calendar?.length)return null;
    const today=typeof ctx.today==='function'?ctx.today():ctx.today;
    const start=Date.parse(ctx.state.intent?.today+'T00:00:00Z'),now=Date.parse(today+'T00:00:00Z');
    const elapsed=Number.isFinite(start)&&Number.isFinite(now)?Math.max(0,Math.floor((now-start)/86400000)):0;
    const week=plan.calendar[Math.min(plan.calendar.length-1,Math.floor(elapsed/7))];
    const dateFor=day=>new Date(start+(day-1)*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
    const startDate=Number.isFinite(start)?dateFor(week.startDay):'';
    const shortDate=day=>day.slice(5).replace('-','/');
    return {...week,startDate,today,dates:startDate?shortDate(startDate)+'—'+shortDate(dateFor(week.endDay)):''};
  }

  function dashboard(ctx) {
    const {state,M,h,icon,buddy,btn} = ctx;
    const profile=state.profile || {}, selected=M.roleFor(state.roleId), lessons=M.lessonsFor(state.roleId);
    const ids=new Set(lessons.map(item=>item.id));
    const done=new Set((state.completedLessons?.[state.branch]||[]).filter(id=>ids.has(id)));
    const studied=new Set([...(state.studiedLessons?.[state.branch]||[]),...done].filter(id=>ids.has(id)));
    const count=done.size,total=lessons.length,remaining=Math.max(0,total-count),percent=total?Math.round(count/total*100):0;
    const days=daysFor(ctx),weekCount=days.filter(day=>day.done).length;
    const checkIns=new Set((ctx.checkInDates||[]).filter(day=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day)));
    const answers=Math.min(6,state.interview?.answers?.length||0),plan=M.planFor(state),window=planWindow(ctx,plan);
    const school=profile.education?.find(item=>item.school)?.school;
    const hasProjectPlan=Boolean(plan&&['B-ai-pm','B-fde'].includes(state.roleId));
    const savedReports=M.reportsFor?.(state)||[],repeating=savedReports.length>0&&!state.interview.finished;
    const next=lessons.find(item=>!done.has(item.id));
    const items=remaining?lessons.map((item,index)=>({...item,index})).filter(item=>!done.has(item.id)).slice(0,3):lessons.slice(0,3).map((item,index)=>({...item,index}));
    const metrics=[
      {label:'知识已学',value:studied.size,unit:`/ ${total} 项`,note:studied.size===total?'知识要点可以随时复习':'先理解知识，再进入练习',glyph:'book'},
      {label:'训练完成',value:count,unit:`/ ${total} 项`,note:remaining?`还有 ${remaining} 项待完成`:'本轮课程练习已完成',glyph:'check'},
      {label:'面试回答',value:answers,unit:'/ 6 轮',note:savedReports.length?`已完成 ${savedReports.length} 次 · 显示本次回答`:'主题问题和追问均已保留',glyph:'chat'},
      {label:'学习打卡',value:checkIns.size,unit:'天',note:`最近七天打卡 ${weekCount} 天`,glyph:'calendar'}
    ];
    return `<section class="j-screen gh-home gh-dashboard gh-monitoring" aria-labelledby="gh-home-title" data-gh-dashboard="monitoring">
      <header class="gh-workspace-heading"><div><p class="gh-kicker">YOUR CAREER WORKSPACE</p><h1 id="gh-home-title">你的学习与准备看板</h1><p>计划、学习和面试记录，都在这里持续更新。</p></div><span class="gh-ready-chip">${icon('check')}面试准备记录已建立</span></header>
      <div class="gh-repeat-entry-grid" aria-label="随时继续练习"><button type="button" class="gh-repeat-entry" data-j-action="OPEN_PRACTICE_CENTER"><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('book')}</span><span><strong>课程练习</strong><small>选择课程，重新做题或复习知识</small></span>${icon('arrow')}</button><button type="button" class="gh-repeat-entry" data-j-action="OPEN_INTERVIEW_PRACTICE"><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('chat')}</span><span><strong>模拟面试</strong><small>${repeating?'继续本次面试，或查看历史报告':'开始新一轮练习，保留已完成报告'}</small></span>${icon('arrow')}</button></div>
      <div class="gh-monitor-hero-grid">
        <section class="gh-overview-profile gh-blue-panel"><div class="gh-overview-person"><p class="gh-kicker">${h(selected?.title||'我的求职方向')}</p><h2>${h(profile.name||'继续向前')}，${repeating?'新一轮，继续练表达。':remaining?'下一步，补齐基础。':hasProjectPlan?'下一步，按计划做作品。':'下一步，把表达练熟。'}</h2><p>${repeating?`上次面试报告已保留。本次已保存 ${answers} / 6 轮回答，可以随时继续。`:remaining?`面试已经走完。还有 ${remaining} 项岗位学习，按自己的节奏继续。`:hasProjectPlan?'本轮课程练习与面试已完成。每周计划中的独立任务与作品仍需实际完成，继续按产出推进。':'岗位训练与本轮面试都已完成。回看复盘，带着准备走向下一次面试。'}</p><div class="gh-overview-actions">${btn(repeating?'继续本次面试':remaining?'继续学习':hasProjectPlan?'继续每周计划':'回看面试复盘',repeating?'START_INTERVIEW':remaining?'RESUME_TRAINING':hasProjectPlan?'SHOW_PLAN':'SHOW_REVIEW')}<button type="button" class="gh-profile-link" data-j-action="SHOW_RESUME">${h(school||'我的个人资料')}${icon('arrow')}</button></div></div><span class="gh-overview-avatar" aria-hidden="true">${profile.photo?`<img class="gh-person-photo" src="${h(profile.photo.dataUrl)}" alt="简历照片">`:buddy?buddy('wave'):'🦦'}</span></section>
        <section class="gh-progress-summary"><div class="gh-progress-ring" style="--gh-progress:${percent}%" role="img" aria-label="岗位训练完成 ${count} 项，共 ${total} 项"><strong>${percent}<small>%</small></strong><span>课程练习进度</span></div><div class="gh-progress-copy"><p>${remaining?'学习还在继续':'完成一轮，继续巩固'}</p><span>${state.trainingSkipped&&remaining?'先面试，再按复盘补学':`${count} 项完成 · ${remaining} 项待学`}</span></div></section>
      </div>
      <div class="gh-monitor-metrics" aria-label="真实准备进度">${metrics.map(metric=>`<article class="gh-metric-card"><span class="gh-metric-heading">${icon(metric.glyph)}${h(metric.label)}</span><div class="gh-metric-value"><strong>${metric.value}</strong><span>${h(metric.unit)}</span></div><p>${h(metric.note)}</p></article>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="gh-dashboard-grid gh-monitoring-layout">
        <section class="gh-module gh-plan-monitor"><div class="gh-module-heading"><div><span class="gh-module-label">我的学习计划</span><h2>${remaining?'从这一项，继续学。':hasProjectPlan?'本周，完成一个实际产出。':'复习一次，讲得更清楚。'}</h2></div><span class="gh-plan-badge">${remaining?`${remaining} 项待学`:hasProjectPlan?'作品按周推进':'可回看复习'}</span></div>${window?weeklyPlan(ctx,window):`<p class="gh-plan-note">${h(selected?.title||'岗位')} · ${remaining?'按顺序学习知识，做完练习，再检验是否掌握。':'把做过的任务换一个情境复做，检查能否独立解释。'}</p>`}${interviewPractice(ctx,savedReports[0])}<ol class="gh-plan-task-list" aria-label="${remaining?'下一步学习任务':'知识复习入口'}">${items.map(item=>{const isDone=done.has(item.id),isNext=next?.id===item.id,status=isDone?'已完成，可重新做题':studied.has(item.id)?'知识已学，继续练习':isNext?'下一项知识学习':'随后学习';return `<li><button type="button" class="gh-plan-task ${isDone?'is-done':''} ${isNext?'is-next':''}" data-j-action="${isDone?'RESTART_LESSON':'RESUME_TRAINING'}" ${isDone?`data-index="${item.index}"`:isNext?'':'disabled'}><span class="gh-plan-task-index">${isDone?icon('check'):String(item.index+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span><strong>${h(item.title)}</strong><small>${h(status)}</small></span>${isDone||isNext?icon('arrow'):lock}</button></li>`}).join('')}</ol><div class="gh-plan-bottom">${btn(remaining?'继续岗位学习':'打开知识复盘',remaining?'RESUME_TRAINING':'SHOW_REVIEW','','secondary')}${plan?btn('查看完整学习计划','SHOW_PLAN','','ghost'):''}</div></section>
        ${checkInCard(ctx,days,weekCount)}
        <button type="button" class="gh-module gh-secondary-module gh-monitor-shortcut" data-j-action="SHOW_RESUME_COMPARE"><span class="gh-module-icon">${icon('file')}</span><span class="gh-module-title">简历前后对比</span><span class="gh-module-description">对照原始内容与整理后的简历。</span><span class="gh-module-entry">查看简历对比${icon('arrow')}</span></button>
        <button type="button" class="gh-module gh-secondary-module gh-monitor-shortcut" data-j-action="OPEN_DASHBOARD_SECTION" data-section="roles"><span class="gh-module-icon">${icon('case')}</span><span class="gh-module-title">岗位方向</span><span class="gh-module-description">当前准备「${h(selected?.title||'我的岗位')}」。</span><span class="gh-module-entry">${state.branch==='B'?'选择或更换意向岗位':'比较岗位方向'}${icon('arrow')}</span></button>
        <button type="button" class="gh-module gh-secondary-module gh-monitor-shortcut" data-j-action="OPEN_DASHBOARD_SECTION" data-section="records"><span class="gh-module-icon">${icon('chart')}</span><span class="gh-module-title">准备报告</span><span class="gh-module-description">${savedReports.length?`${savedReports.length}次已完成面试报告`:`${answers}轮回答与追问`}，随时回看。</span><span class="gh-module-entry">查看准备报告${icon('arrow')}</span></button>
      </div>
    </section>`;
  }

  function importPage(ctx) {
    const {state,h,icon,btn} = ctx, importing=ctx.importing===true;
    const hasProfile=Boolean(state.profile);
    return `<section class="j-screen gh-import-page" aria-labelledby="gh-import-title"><div class="gh-import-heading"><p class="gh-kicker">第 1 步 / 共 5 步</p><h1 id="gh-import-title">先放入你的简历。</h1><p>读取教育背景、工作经历与技能。下一步，再由你核对和完善。</p></div>
      <div class="gh-import-layout"><div class="gh-import-panel"><div class="gh-file-symbol" aria-hidden="true">${icon('upload')}</div><h2>${hasProfile?'换一份简历，重新整理。':'让求职准备，有一个真实的起点。'}</h2><p>${hasProfile?`已上传：${h(state.upload?.name||'我的简历')}。重新上传后，将从个人资料开始重新确认。`:'选择一份简历，系统会整理出可核对、可修改的个人资料。'}</p><label class="gh-file-choose ${importing?'is-loading':''}"><input id="journey-file" type="file" aria-label="${hasProfile?'重新上传我的简历':'上传我的简历'}" accept=".pdf,.docx,.txt,.md" ${importing?'disabled':''}><span>${icon(importing?'file':'upload')}${importing?'正在读取简历…':hasProfile?'选择新的简历':'上传我的简历'}</span></label><span class="gh-file-formats">PDF · DOCX · TXT · 建议使用文字清晰的文件</span>${ctx.uploadError?`<p class="j-error gh-import-error" role="alert">${h(ctx.uploadError)}</p>`:''}${importing?'<p class="gh-import-status" role="status">正在读取内容，完成后会回到首页，点亮第二步。</p>':''}<div class="gh-import-footer"><span>暂时没有简历？</span><button type="button" class="gh-text-link" data-j-action="DOWNLOAD_PREPARED">下载体验简历 PDF${icon('arrow')}</button></div></div>
      <aside class="gh-import-guide gh-blue-panel"><p class="gh-kicker">准备路线</p><h2>先上传，<br>再慢慢完善。</h2><ol><li><span>01</span><div><strong>上传简历</strong><p>用你准备好的文件开始。</p></div></li><li><span>02</span><div><strong>回首页，点第二步</strong><p>核对资料与整理后的简历。</p></div></li><li><span>03</span><div><strong>继续点亮下一步</strong><p>方向、学习、面试依次展开。</p></div></li></ol></aside></div>
      <div class="gh-import-actions">${btn('返回五步首页','SHOW_HOME','','ghost')}</div></section>`;
  }

  globalThis.CareerJourneyHomeViews=Object.freeze({home,importPage,checkInBurst});
})();

<script>
/* Resume presentation is separate from the uploaded facts and saved journey. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const esc=value=>String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const has=item=>Boolean(item.school||item.organization||item.role||item.bullets?.length);
  function paper(profile,{h=esc}={}){
    if(globalThis.CareerJourneyResume?.previewHTML)return globalThis.CareerJourneyResume.previewHTML(profile);
    const p=profile||{},education=(p.education||[]).filter(has),experiences=(p.experiences||[]).filter(has);
    const list=items=>`<ul>${items.filter(Boolean).map(text=>`<li>${h(text)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`;
    const contacts=[p.email,p.phone,p.location].filter(Boolean);
    return `<article class="j-resume-paper jr-document" aria-label="排版后的简历"><header class="jr-document-header"><div class="jr-initial" aria-hidden="true">${h(p.name?.slice(-1)||'履')}</div><div><p class="j-resume-kicker">CURRICULUM VITAE</p><h2>${h(p.name||'待补充姓名')}</h2>${p.headline?`<p class="jr-headline">${h(p.headline)}</p>`:''}${p.goal?`<p class="jr-goal">求职意向 · ${h(p.goal)}</p>`:''}<div class="j-resume-contact">${contacts.map(text=>`<span>${h(text)}</span>`).join('')}</div></div></header><div class="jr-document-columns"><aside class="jr-document-sidebar">${education.length?`<section class="j-resume-section"><h3><small>EDUCATION</small>教育背景</h3>${education.map(e=>`<div class="jr-education"><strong>${h(e.school)}</strong><p>${h([e.degree,e.major].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</p><span class="jr-period">${h(e.period)}</span>${list(e.details||[])}</div>`).join('')}</section>`:''}${p.skills?.length?`<section class="j-resume-section"><h3><small>SKILLS</small>技能与证书</h3>${list(p.skills)}</section>`:''}</aside><div class="jr-document-main">${p.summary?`<section class="j-resume-section jr-summary"><h3><small>PROFILE</small>个人简介</h3><p>${h(p.summary)}</p></section>`:''}<section class="j-resume-section"><h3><small>EXPERIENCE</small>实习与项目经历</h3>${experiences.map(e=>`<div class="j-resume-entry"><div><strong>${h(e.organization)}</strong><span>${h(e.period)}</span></div>${e.role?`<p class="j-resume-role">${h(e.role)}</p>`:''}${list(e.bullets||[])}</div>`).join('')}</section></div></div></article>`;
  }
  function changes(polish,{h=esc}={}){
    if(!polish)return '';
    const stats=polish.stats||{},items=(polish.changes||[]).filter(x=>x.before!==x.after);
    return `<section class="jr-optimization-summary" aria-label="简历优化结果"><div class="jr-summary-heading"><div><span class="ws-stage-pill">${polish.manuallyEdited?'已保存手动修改':polish.applied?'已使用美化版':'美化版已生成'}</span><h2>把重点写清楚</h2><p>${polish.manuallyEdited?'当前预览已包含你的修改，可以直接导出。':'删掉重复的话，保留你做过的事和原有数字。'}</p></div>${!polish.manuallyEdited&&stats.beforeCharacters?`<div class="jr-word-count"><strong>${h(stats.beforeCharacters)} <span>→</span> ${h(stats.afterCharacters)}</strong><small>正文字符 · 核心经历完整保留</small></div>`:''}</div>${items.length?`<details class="jr-change-details"><summary>看看${polish.manuallyEdited?'自动优化时':'这次'}改了什么 · ${items.length}处</summary><div class="jr-change-list">${items.map(change=>`<article><h3>${h(change.label||'表达优化')}</h3><div><section><span>优化前</span><p>${h(change.before)}</p></section><section><span>优化后</span><p>${h(change.after)}</p></section></div></article>`).join('')}</div></details>`:''}${polish.reviewNotes?.length?`<details class="jr-review-notes"><summary>导出前，确认这${polish.reviewNotes.length}处信息</summary><ul>${polish.reviewNotes.map(note=>`<li>${h(note)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></details>`:''}</section>`;
  }
  function fileToken(icon,name='',h=esc){
    const ext=String(name).match(/\.(pdf|docx|txt|md)$/i)?.[1]?.toUpperCase();
    return `<div class="jr-file-token" data-j-resume-file><span class="jr-file-glyph" aria-hidden="true">${icon('file')}${ext?`<b>${h(ext)}</b>`:''}</span>${name?`<strong>${h(name)}</strong>`:''}</div>`;
  }
  function upload({state,h=esc,icon,btn,importing=false,uploadError=''}){
    const existing=Boolean(state.profile);
    return `<section class="j-screen jr-flow" aria-labelledby="jr-upload-title">
      <header class="jr-hero"><p class="jr-eyebrow">第 1 步 · 我的简历</p><h1 id="jr-upload-title">${existing?'换一份简历，重新整理。':'先放入你的简历。'}</h1><p>从简历中提取教育背景、工作经历和技能，接着由你核对。</p></header>
      <div class="jr-upload-layout">
        <div class="jr-drop-target" data-j-resume-drop aria-busy="${importing}">
          ${fileToken(icon,existing?state.upload?.name||'当前简历':'',h)}
          <h2>${importing?'正在整理文件…':'把文件拖到这里，或直接选择。'}</h2>
          <p>PDF、DOCX、TXT 或 Markdown</p>
          <label class="j-btn primary jr-upload-pick"><input id="journey-file" type="file" accept=".pdf,.docx,.txt,.md" aria-label="${existing?'重新上传我的简历':'上传我的简历'}" ${importing?'disabled':''}><span>${icon('upload')}${importing?'正在读取简历…':existing?'选择新的简历':'上传我的简历'}</span></label>
          ${importing?'<p class="jr-upload-status" role="status">正在读取文件，完成后会点亮简历核对。</p>':''}
          ${uploadError?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(uploadError)}</p>`:''}
        </div>
        <aside class="j-card jr-guide"><p class="jr-eyebrow">上传之后</p><h2>把经历写清楚。</h2><ol><li><b>核对经历</b><span>确认学校、项目和工作内容。</span></li><li><b>美化与对比</b><span>把重点放前面，核对原文和新版。</span></li><li><b>导出 PDF</b><span>带着整理好的简历进入岗位选择。</span></li></ol>
        <button type="button" class="j-btn ghost small" data-j-action="DOWNLOAD_PREPARED">下载体验简历 PDF</button></aside>
      </div><div class="j-actions">${btn('返回准备概览','SHOW_HOME','','ghost')}</div>
    </section>`;
  }
  function resumeFacts(profile){
    return globalThis.CareerJourneyResume?.profileCounts?.(profile)||[
      ['教育背景',(profile.education||[]).filter(item=>item.school||item.major||item.degree||item.details?.length).length,'段'],
      ['工作与项目',(profile.experiences||[]).filter(item=>item.organization||item.role||item.bullets?.length).length,'段'],
      ['技能与证书',(profile.skills||[]).filter(Boolean).length,'项'],
    ].filter(([,count])=>count>0);
  }
  function review({state,h=esc,icon,btn,editing,editor,resumePaper,uploadError}){
    const profile=state.profile,polish=state.resumePolish;
    const polished=Boolean(polish&&state.resumeView==='polished');
    const active=polish?(polished?polish.draft:polish.original):profile;
    const facts=resumeFacts(active);
    return `<section class="j-screen jr-flow" aria-labelledby="jr-review-title">
      <header class="jr-hero"><p class="jr-eyebrow">${state.onboardingComplete?'我的简历':'第 2 步 · 核对经历'}</p><h1 id="jr-review-title">${polished?'新版简历好了。':'看看简历里的信息对不对。'}</h1><p>先核对事实，再优化表达和版式。所有内容都可以修改，核对后可导出 PDF。</p></header>
      ${profile.extractionWarnings?.length?`<div class="gh-extraction-note"><strong>这几处需要你确认</strong><ul>${profile.extractionWarnings.map(text=>`<li>${h(text)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div>`:''}
      ${state.error?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(state.error)}</p>`:''}
      <div class="j-resume-toolbar">
        ${polish?`<div class="jr-version-tabs" role="group" aria-label="简历版本">${btn('优化前','SHOW_ORIGINAL_RESUME',`aria-pressed="${!polished}"`,'ghost '+(!polished?'is-selected':''))}${btn('美化版','SHOW_POLISHED_RESUME',`aria-pressed="${polished}"`,'ghost '+(polished?'is-selected':''))}</div>${btn('查看前后对比','SHOW_RESUME_COMPARE')}`:btn('优化并美化简历','OPTIMIZE_RESUME')}
        ${btn(polished?'导出美化版PDF':'导出PDF简历','EXPORT_PDF','','secondary')}
        ${btn(editing?'收起修改':polished?'修改这版内容':'修改简历','EDIT_RESUME','','ghost')}
        <label class="j-btn secondary jr-photo-input">${profile.photo?'更换简历照片':'添加简历照片'}<input id="journey-photo-file" type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" aria-label="${profile.photo?'更换简历照片':'添加简历照片'}"></label>
      </div>
      <div class="jr-review-layout">
        <div class="jr-reading-column">
          ${editing?editor():`<div class="jr-paper-anchor" data-j-resume-paper>${resumePaper()}</div>`}
          ${polished?changes(polish,{h}):''}
        </div>
        <aside class="j-card jr-guide jr-review-aside">
          ${fileToken(icon,state.upload?.name||'当前简历',h)}
          ${facts.length?`<dl class="jr-resume-facts">${facts.map(([label,count,unit])=>`<div><dt>${label}</dt><dd><b>${count}</b> ${unit}</dd></div>`).join('')}</dl>`:''}
          <h2>${polished?'用这份简历继续。':'从这份简历出发。'}</h2>
          <p>${polished?'看过新版，确认文字准确后，就可以开始选方向。':'核对并补充你的经历，然后填写求职意向和可投入的时间。'}</p>
          ${btn(polished?'使用这版，继续 →':state.careerPreferences?'确认资料，返回首页':'确认资料，继续 →',polished?'APPLY_AND_CONFIRM_RESUME':'CONFIRM_RESUME')}
          ${polish?btn('恢复优化前内容','RESTORE_ORIGINAL_RESUME','','ghost small'):''}
          <label class="j-replace-file">换一份简历<input id="journey-replace-file" type="file" accept=".pdf,.docx,.txt,.md"></label>
        </aside>
      </div>
      ${uploadError?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(uploadError)}</p>`:''}
    </section>`;
  }
  function compare({state,h=esc,icon,btn}){
    const polish=state.resumePolish,original=polish?.original||state.profile,draft=polish?.draft||state.profile;
    return `<section class="j-screen jr-flow" aria-labelledby="jr-compare-title">
      <header class="jr-hero"><p class="jr-eyebrow">简历前后对比</p><h1 id="jr-compare-title">原稿和${polish?'美化版':'整理版'}，并排看看。</h1><p>核对经历、时间和数字，再把整理好的版本带进求职计划。</p></header>
      <div class="gh-compare-grid jr-comparison">
        <section class="j-card jr-source-column"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>上传时</h2><span class="ws-stage-pill">原始内容</span></div>
          ${fileToken(icon,state.upload?.name||'已上传文件',h)}
          <pre class="gh-source-preview">${h(original.sourceText||'原文件内容暂不可用，请重新上传后对比。')}</pre>
        </section>
        <section class="j-card jr-result-column"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>${polish?'美化后':'核对后'}</h2><span class="ws-stage-pill">可导出 PDF</span></div>
          <div class="jr-paper-anchor" data-j-resume-paper>${paper(draft,{h})}</div>
        </section>
      </div>
      <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn(polish?'返回美化版':'返回简历核对',polish?'SHOW_POLISHED_RESUME':'SHOW_RESUME')}${btn('导出PDF简历','EXPORT_PDF','data-resume-variant="polished"','secondary')}${btn('返回准备概览','SHOW_HOME','','ghost')}</div>
    </section>`;
  }
  function transition(before,after,paint){
    const documentStep=after.screen==='resume'&&(before.screen!=='resume'||before.resumeView!==after.resumeView||before.upload?.name!==after.upload?.name);
    if(!documentStep&&after.screen!=='compare')return paint();
    const doc=globalThis.document,motion=globalThis.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    if(motion?.matches||doc?.documentElement?.classList?.contains('demo-motion-off')||!doc?.querySelector)return paint();
    const previous=doc.querySelector('[data-j-resume-paper] .jr-preview-sheet')||doc.querySelector('.jr-drop-target [data-j-resume-file] .jr-file-glyph')||doc.querySelector('[data-j-action="OPEN_ONBOARDING_STEP"][data-index="2"]');
    const origin=previous?.getBoundingClientRect?.();
    paint();
    const sheet=doc.querySelector('[data-j-resume-paper] .jr-preview-sheet');
    if(!sheet?.animate)return;
    globalThis.requestAnimationFrame?.(()=>{
      if(!sheet.isConnected)return;
      const bounds=sheet.getBoundingClientRect();
      const duration=after.screen==='compare'?385:320;
      const options={duration,easing:'cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.25,1)'};
      if(origin?.width>0&&bounds.width>0&&bounds.top<globalThis.innerHeight&&origin.bottom>0){
        const scale=Math.max(.68,Math.min(1.18,origin.width/bounds.width));
        const x=origin.left+origin.width/2-bounds.left-bounds.width/2;
        const y=Math.max(-190,Math.min(190,origin.top-bounds.top));
        sheet.animate([{opacity:.4,transform:`translate(${x}px,${y}px) scale(${scale})`,transformOrigin:'50% 0%'},{opacity:1,transform:'none',transformOrigin:'50% 0%'}],options);
      }else sheet.animate([{opacity:.4,transform:'translateY(12px)'},{opacity:1,transform:'none'}],options);
      doc.querySelector('.jr-source-column')?.animate?.([{opacity:0,transform:'translateX(-18px)'},{opacity:1,transform:'none'}],options);
    });
  }
  globalThis.CareerJourneyResumeViews=Object.freeze({paper,changes,upload,review,compare,transition});
})();

</script>
<script>

      steps:['把问题缩成一个具体环节，先回答发生了什么。','查表中是否有回答问题需要的字段；没有的结果不能猜。','写下时间和记录范围，再决定计算什么。'],
      takeaway:'能描述现象，不等于已经解释原因。先有可回答的问题，再开始处理数据。'

      terms:[['完全重复','编号和业务内容均相同的重复记录。'],['缺失值','没有记录到的信息，含义是未知，不自动等于0或否。'],['分析用表','按本次已说明的规则筛选出的数据版本。']],
      steps:['复制原始表，保留来源与日期，另建分析用表和核对清单。','按业务编号排序或筛选，对照其余字段；状态不同可能是更新，不能直接删。','完全重复保留一条；关键缺项先列待核对，写下原因和回填要求。'],

      title:'百分比先找对分子和分母',

      steps:['先完整写出指标名称，圈出本题讨论的业务环节。','把结果数放分子，把进入该环节的对象数放分母。','相除后设为百分比，标清时间和样本量；分母为0时说明无法计算。'],

      steps:['先报告数量和范围，不急着说好坏。','把一种可能原因明确写成“待验证”，并考虑其他解释。','选择能区分这些解释的核验动作，再持续跟踪同口径数据。'],
      takeaway:'0个结果值得核对，但不直接证明一个渠道永远无效。观察周、样本量和记录完整性都影响解释。'

      steps:['保留原始表、处理规则和分析用版本，说明统计范围。','用一个指标和一张合适的图呈现事实，同时写出限制。','提出能落实的核验动作，约定负责人和检查时间。'],

    'hr-status': {title:'状态与待办，要同时写清',concept:'状态说明现在已经发生什么；待办说明还差什么。把两者分开，下一位同事才能继续处理。',terms:[['当前事实','已有来源能支持的状态。'],['下一动作','接下来需要完成的一件具体事情。'],['检查时间','负责人回看进度的明确时点。']],steps:['先写已完成且核实过的部分。','再写未完成事项与当前阻塞。','补上责任人与检查时间，避免“大家再跟进”。'],takeaway:'看板不是把每格都写成完成。准确呈现还没做完的部分，才有交接价值。'},
    'hr-records': {title:'汇总之前，先核对记录',concept:'记录行数不一定等于业务数量。汇报前要先核对编号、重复、缺项和状态来源。',terms:[['业务编号','用于追踪一条具体业务记录。'],['关键缺项','会影响当前统计定义的未知信息。'],['核对清单','保留编号、问题、来源和下一动作。']],steps:['保留原始表，说明统计范围。','核对相同编号及其余字段，不把状态更新误删为重复。','把待核实项单列并记录处理规则，使用明确的分析版本。'],takeaway:'未知不是0，待核对不是删除。口径说明要和汇总结果一起交付。'},

  function contentFor(lesson,role) {
    if(lesson?.teaching)return {...lesson.teaching,isData:false,specialized:true,pages:3};
    const isData=Boolean(copy[lesson?.id]);
    const pack=packs[role?.id]||packs['B-people-data'];
    const content=copy[lesson?.id]||practical[lesson?.id]||{title:'先理解这项岗位任务',concept:lesson?.explain||'先核对任务目标、来源和交付标准，再开始练习。',terms:[['目标','本次要完成什么。'],['依据','需要哪些已核实的信息。'],['交付','别人怎样确认这项任务完成。']],steps:['问清任务和范围。','对照信息与处理规则。','留下输出与待核对项。'],takeaway:'先学方法，再用新的任务检验自己。'};
    return {...content,isData,pack,example:{...sample,channels:[...sample.channels]},pages:3};
  }

  function flow(items,h) {return `<div class="jt-flow">${items.map((item,index)=>`<div><span>0${index+1}</span><strong>${h(item)}</strong></div>${index<items.length-1?'<i aria-hidden="true">→</i>':''}`).join('')}</div>`;}
  function table(headers,rows,h) {return `<div class="jt-table-scroll" tabindex="0"><table class="jt-example-table"><thead><tr>${headers.map(text=>`<th>${h(text)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(row=>`<tr>${row.map(text=>`<td>${h(text)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;}
  function chips(content,h) {return `<dl class="jt-terms">${content.terms.map(([term,definition])=>`<div><dt>${h(term)}</dt><dd>${h(definition)}</dd></div>`).join('')}</dl>`;}

  function conceptVisual(lesson,content,h) {
    if(content.specialized)return flow(content.conceptFlow||content.steps,h);
    const p=content.pack;
    if(lesson.id==='data-goal')return flow(['要回答的问题','需要的字段','范围与规则','能支持的结论'],h);
    if(lesson.id==='data-read')return `<div class="jt-grain-card"><span>一行</span><strong>一条${h(p.unit)}记录</strong><p>编号定位对象；来源负责分组；两个状态分别记录不同环节。</p></div>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-clean'||lesson.id==='hr-records')return flow(['原始表保留','按编号核对','问题单列待核对','说明分析口径'],h);
    if(lesson.id==='data-metric')return `<div class="jt-equation jt-symbolic"><span>目标结果数</span><b>÷</b><span>进入该环节的对象数</span><b>× 100%</b></div>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-chart')return `<div class="jt-chart-types"><div><span aria-hidden="true">▰ ▰ ▰</span><strong>类别数量 → 条形图</strong><p>比较组与组的大小。</p></div><div><span aria-hidden="true">▁▃▂▅</span><strong>随时间变化 → 折线图</strong><p>需要真实的时间先后。</p></div></div>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-insight')return flow(['我看到了什么','可能是什么原因','还要查什么'],h);
    if(lesson.id==='data-brief')return flow(['问题与范围','处理与结果','限制与行动'],h);
    return flow(['先确认事实','再记录下一步','留下检查依据'],h);
  }

  function workedVisual(lesson,content,h) {
    if(content.specialized){
      const worked=content.worked||{};
      return `<div class="jc-worked"><span class="jc-course-case">跟做案例 · ${h(worked.title||'看一个完整例子')}</span>${worked.intro?`<p class="jc-example-intro">${h(worked.intro)}</p>`:''}${worked.headers?table(worked.headers,worked.rows||[],h):''}${worked.flow?flow(worked.flow,h):''}${worked.conclusion?`<div class="jt-callout"><strong>为什么这样做</strong><p>${h(worked.conclusion)}</p></div>`:''}</div>`;
    }
    const p=content.pack;
    if(lesson.id==='data-goal')return `<div class="jt-worked-question"><small>用另一份小表练方法 · ${h(p.title)}</small><h3>${h(p.question)}</h3>${flow([p.key,p.middle,p.end,p.time],h)}<p>这些字段能描述当前环节；表里没有后续结果，就不预测后续结果。</p></div>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-read')return `${table([p.key,p.channel,p.middle,p.end],[['D03',p.channels[0],'是','否']],h)}<div class="jt-callout"><strong>逐列读一遍</strong><p>D03 是一条${h(p.unit)}；来自${h(p.channels[0])}，已进入${h(p.middle)}环节，但还没有${h(p.end)}。它不能被写成已完成结果。</p></div>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-clean'||lesson.id==='hr-records')return `${table(['记录',p.key,p.channel,p.middle,p.end,'核对结果'],[['N01','D01',p.channels[0],'是','是','保留'],['N03','D03',p.channels[1],'是','否','保留首条'],['N03-copy','D03',p.channels[1],'是','否','与N03完全重复，待核对'],['N09','D09','未知','未知','未知','关键缺项，待核对']],h)}<p class="jt-example-note">表中只展示需要解释的片段。完整原表共10行，1行重复、1行关键缺项；原始表保留，分析用表先纳入8条。</p><div class="jt-mini-metrics"><div><strong>10</strong><span>原始记录</span></div><div><strong>2</strong><span>待核对</span></div><div><strong>8</strong><span>本次分析用</span></div></div><div class="jt-callout"><strong>别只看编号像不像</strong><p>N03-copy 与 N03 都对应业务编号 D03，其他字段也相同。若其他字段不同，应先核对是否是状态更新，不能直接移除。</p></div>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-metric')return `<p class="jt-example-context">${h(p.title)} · ${h(p.time)}：8条有效${h(p.unit)}，其中6条${h(p.middle)}、3条${h(p.end)}。</p><div class="jt-metric-funnel"><div><strong>8</strong><span>全部有效${h(p.unit)}</span></div><div><strong>6</strong><span>${h(p.middle)} · 本题分母</span></div><div><strong>3</strong><span>${h(p.end)} · 本题分子</span></div></div><div class="jt-equation"><span>3</span><b>÷</b><span>6</span><b>× 100%</b><em>= 50%</em></div><p><strong>${h(p.rate)} = 50%。</strong>如果改用全部8条作分母，回答的就是另一个业务问题，不能仍用同一个指标名。</p><div class="jt-tool-tip"><span>表格工具试一试</span><code>=IF(C2=0,"",D2/C2)</code><p>C2放本题分母，D2放分子；单元格设为“百分比”。分母为0时留空并标明无法计算。</p></div>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-chart')return `<p class="jt-example-context">比较${h(p.title)}的来源数量。共8条有效${h(p.unit)}，三组为4、2、2条。</p><figure class="jt-bars"><figcaption>不同来源的${h(p.unit)}数量（条）</figcaption>${p.channels.map((name,index)=>`<div class="jt-bar-row"><span>${h(name)}</span><div><i style="width:${sample.channels[index]/4*100}%"></i><strong>${sample.channels[index]}</strong></div></div>`).join('')}<div class="jt-axis"><span>0</span><span>2</span><span>4 条</span></div></figure><p>数量轴从0开始；每组直接标数值。三组没有时间先后，不能把它们连成“趋势”。</p>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-insight')return `<div class="jt-insight-stack"><div><span>已知事实</span><strong>${h(p.channels[1])}有2条${h(p.unit)}，2条${h(p.middle)}，0条${h(p.end)}。</strong></div><div><span>待验证的解释</span><p>可能是流程尚未结束，也可能是记录没有及时更新；当前表还不能区分。</p></div><div><span>下一步核验</span><p>${h(p.follow)}；对齐观察时间，再用相同口径继续跟踪。</p></div></div><p class="jt-example-note">这个小样本可以提示一个问题，还不足以判断渠道长期表现或确定因果。</p>`;
    if(lesson.id==='data-brief')return `<div class="jt-brief-sheet"><div><span>问题与范围</span><p>${h(p.question)} 范围：${h(p.time)}。</p></div><div><span>数据与处理</span><p>原始10行，2行单列待核对，先按8条完整记录分析；保留原表和处理说明。</p></div><div><span>指标与事实</span><p>6条${h(p.middle)}，3条${h(p.end)}，${h(p.rate)}为50%。</p></div><div><span>限制</span><p>仅一个观察周期、小样本；待核对项回填后需要复算。</p></div><div><span>下一动作</span><p>由记录负责人在下一个工作日核对状态来源；复算后更新小结并记录版本。</p></div></div>`;
    if(lesson.id==='hr-coordinate')return `<div class="jt-time-match"><div><small>面试官可选</small><strong>周二 14:00 / 17:00</strong></div><div><small>候选人明确回复</small><strong>周二 17:00 可以参加</strong></div><div class="jt-time-result"><small>完成双方核对后</small><strong>确认 17:00，发送方式与地点</strong></div></div><p>如果候选人尚未回复，记录仍是“候选人待确认”，同时留下提醒时间。</p>`;
    if(lesson.id==='hr-status')return `<div class="jt-status-example"><div><span>已核实</span><strong>资料已收到</strong></div><div><span>还没完成</span><strong>附件版本待确认</strong></div><div><span>下一步</span><strong>资料协调人今天16:00联系来源方</strong></div></div><p>这条任务不能写成“资料全部完成”，因为版本尚未确认。</p>`;
    return `<div class="jt-brief-sheet"><div><span>对象</span><p>培训报名 D09 · 来源待核对。</p></div><div><span>动作与依据</span><p>向原记录人核对来源，保留回复位置，不猜测填写。</p></div><div><span>责任与检查</span><p>培训协调人负责，下个工作日12:00检查；仍未核实则向负责人说明。</p></div></div>`;
  }

  function render(ctx) {
    const {lesson,role}=ctx;
    if(!lesson)return '';
    const h=ctx.h||escape, content=contentFor(lesson,role), supplied=Number(ctx.studyPage);
    const page=Number.isFinite(supplied)?Math.max(0,Math.min(2,Math.floor(supplied))):0;
    const button=(text,action,kind='primary')=>ctx.btn?ctx.btn(text,action,'',kind):`<button type="button" class="j-btn ${kind}" data-j-action="${action}">${h(text)}</button>`;
    const body=page===0
      ? `<p class="jt-lead">${h(content.concept)}</p>${conceptVisual(lesson,content,h)}${chips(content,h)}`
      :page===1
        ? `${workedVisual(lesson,content,h)}${content.isData?'<div class="jt-transfer-note"><strong>接下来换一份招聘数据练习。</strong><p>业务和数值会变化，请重新读字段、定义分母，使用刚学的方法。</p></div>':''}`
        : `<ol class="jt-method-list">${content.steps.map((step,index)=>`<li><b>0${index+1}</b><span>${h(step)}</span></li>`).join('')}</ol><div class="jt-takeaway"><span>带走一句话</span><h3>${h(content.takeaway)}</h3></div><p class="jt-practice-ready">现在再进入练习。遇到不确定的地方，可以随时回来看方法。</p>`;
    return `<section class="jt-lesson" aria-labelledby="jt-title"><header class="jt-header"><div><p class="jt-kicker">先学知识 · ${h(role?.title||'岗位准备')}</p><h2 id="jt-title">${h(content.title)}</h2></div><span class="jt-page-count">${page+1} / 3</span></header><ol class="jt-page-map" aria-label="本课知识进度">${pageTitles.map((title,index)=>`<li class="${index===page?'current':index<page?'visited':''}" ${index===page?'aria-current="step"':''}><span>${index+1}</span>${title}</li>`).join('')}</ol><div class="jt-page-content" data-study-page="${page}"><h3 class="jt-page-heading">${page===0?'先建立一个清楚的概念':page===1?(content.specialized?'跟着一个不同情境做判断':'跟着另一份数据走一遍'):'把方法整理成自己的步骤'}</h3>${body}</div><nav class="jt-actions" aria-label="知识讲解翻页">${page>0?button('上一节知识','STUDY_PREV','ghost'):'<span class="jt-first-page-note">先了解概念，再看操作。</span>'}${page<2?button(page===0?'下一节：跟着做一次':'下一节：记住方法','STUDY_NEXT'):button('我学会了，开始练习','START_PRACTICE')}</nav></section>`;
  }

  globalThis.CareerJourneyTeaching=Object.freeze({render,contentFor,pageCount:3});
})();

</script>
